entities.summary: Pietro della Vigna was an Italian jurist and diplomat, who acted as chancellor and secretary (logothete) to Emperor Frederick II. Accused of lèse-majesté, he was imprisoned and blinded, committing suicide soon after. He appears as a character in the Inferno of the Divine Comedy by Dante Alighieri.
